subject: Secure weights procurement & ISV channel playbook
messages:
From: Partners Team <partners@openharbor.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Distribution via Redwood marketplace — initial intake

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. OpenHarbor is very interested in productizing our top-tier 8B/30B weights through Redwood's marketplace and ISV channels. High-level asks:

- Controlled weights access (time-limited keys or escrowed transfer)
- Ability to onboard ISV resellers under a managed distribution agreement
- Provenance and checksum verification for each artifact
- Clear commercial routing (rev-share + reseller uplift)

We attached a short summary (see stub: weights_manifest.csv) and would like to run a short mutual action plan to scope technical handoff + legal.

Prefer to loop in your partnerships and sales leads to map next steps — copying Ava Consulting who would act as our integration partner for packaging and A/B evaluation.

Thanks,
Ben Kramer
Business Development 
OpenHarbor Models
attachments: weights_manifest.csv (text/csv)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Kramer <partners@openharbor.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Distribution via Redwood marketplace — initial intake

Ben — thanks for the note and the manifest. Happy to take this on.

Camila / Sergio — looped you both for partnership and publisher terms. High-level questions to unblock scoping:

1) Do you require a third-party escrow (we've worked with JurisSafe and ModelCustody) or would you accept Redwood-managed ephemeral access with an HSM-backed key?
2) What licensing model do you prefer (non-commercial evaluation, ISV redistribution with attribution, or per-seat commercial license)?
3) Any embargo or ranking restrictions (e.g., gating large-batch public mirrors for N months)?

If we can get answers to those 3 we can draft a short mutual action plan and attach a DPA + onboarding checklist. I'll start a draft M.A.P. and ask Camila to run the publisher intake.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Head of Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Kramer <partners@openharbor.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Publisher intake + draft MAP (attached)

Ben / team — attaching two stubs: Redwood_ISV_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and Weights_Access_DPA_v1.pdf (see attachments). Key points from our side:

* Recommended default: Redwood-managed temporary access (signed token + KV cache boundary) for proof-of-concept and an optional escrow handoff for production distribution. We recommend escrow when the publisher requires a complete copy transfer to a reseller.
* Suggested license archetype: ISV Redistribution + Attribution (tiered rev-share) — we can tailor specifics after your finance team shares target pricing.
* Security gating: SOC2 Type II evidence, sample checksum audit, and signed provenance manifest.
* Rollout cadence: 2-week POC -> 4-week ISV onboarding -> production marketplace listing.

Action items (proposed MAP):
1) OpenHarbor: confirm escrow requirement (yes/no) and preferred escrow vendor (if yes) — due 9/18
2) Redwood partnerships: prepare DPA + sample reseller contract — due 9/20
3) Ava Consulting: scope packaging and test harness — due 9/22
4) Commercial: Naomi to produce indicative rev-share range and deal construct — due 9/24

Ben — can you confirm points 1 & 3 above? If you prefer escrow, please name the vendor. We can begin drafting the DocuSign package once confirmed.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_ISV_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, Weights_Access_DPA_v1.pdf
From: Ben Kramer <partners@openharbor.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ava Consulting <contacts@avaconsult.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publisher intake + draft MAP (attached)

Camila — thanks for the clear MAP. Short answers:

1) Escrow: Yes, OpenHarbor prefers an escrow handoff for any re-sellable model artifacts. Preferred vendors: ModelCustody or TrustWeights (we have existing relationships).
2) Packaging: Ava Consulting will do the packaging and provide the test harness. They estimate 2 FTE-weeks for the POC.
3) Embargo: we request a 60-day embargo on unrestricted public mirrors post-listing to protect our go-to-market.

Next: we'll review your DPA and aim to confirm the escrow vendor by 9/20. If Redwood can provide a templated escrow workflow (contacts, SOW skeleton) that will speed this up.

Best,
Ben
OpenHarbor Models
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Kramer <partners@openharbor.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial parameters + next steps

Ben / team — quick commercial note so legal can align with business:

- Indicative rev-share range: 65/35 (publisher/Redwood) for direct marketplace sales; ISV reseller uplift negotiated case-by-case.
- Minimum annual commitment for Dedicated listing: $45k if publisher wants guaranteed availability.
- Deal ID: OHM-2026-0421 (please reference in any SOWs).
- Region note: We will initially list in US and EU regions; EU legal team will need to review the DPA addendum for data residency.

Camila: please attach the DocuSign when legal is ready. Ben: once you confirm escrow vendor (ModelCustody or TrustWeights), we'll loop in Finance to set the billing and payout cadence.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
